name: Shepperton Open Water Swim
summary: Ferris Meadow Lake is a dedicated natural open-water swimming venue in Shepperton. Sessions must be booked, and new swimmers complete an induction and swim test before using the lake.
reasonToVisit: A dedicated open-water swimming lake with induction sessions for new swimmers
planningDetail: Adult-focused venue with specific coaching requirements for under-18s — read all safety and booking information first
